provenance._note: RE-MEASURED 2026-07-02 on hipx warm force-high (median of 3, dram_over_cache_ratio ~2.4x passes residency guard, issue #490 CLOSED): mem_latency_ns=214.124 ns is the real DRAM latency. Prior deflated committed value=169.719 ns was CACHE-DEFLATED — the 128 MiB buffer cleared this part's 96 MiB IC + 6 MiB L2 by only 1.3x. Re-measure under the 408 MiB buffer + residency guard. RX 7900 XTX / gfx1100 (RDNA3), hipx zoo card (also the k9lin fleet arch), WARM force-high mclk sweep, 2026-07-02. Static fields (vgprs_per_simd=1536, max_waves_per_simd=16, lds_bytes_per_cu=65536, wavefront_size=32) are read directly from the single source of truth profiler.rs::arch_spec('gfx1100'|'gfx1101'|'gfx1102' RDNA3 arm) + ArchCaps::is_wave32() — not hand-recalled. cu_count=96 is from rocminfo/KFD topology on the live card (the 7900 XTX is the full Navi 31 die at 96 CU; profiler.rs's fallback const 'gfx1100'=>48 is the smaller RX 7800 XT SKU and correctly does NOT apply here — per-device row, same rationale as gfx1201's R9700-vs-9070-XT split). vram_mb=24576 (24GB RX 7900 XTX). mem_latency_ns=169.719 [RETRACTED per #490 — this WARM number was cache-deflated (buffer <= IC); the row is now WITHHELD/null pending re-measurement, see the WITHHELD header above] was MEASURED WARM via pointer_chase_latency at power_dpm_force_performance_level=high — closely corroborates the earlier cross-arch WARM sweep noted in gfx1201.json's provenance (gfx1100=169.7 ns there too). peak_bw_gbps=809.0 is the DRAM-bound large-buffer PLATEAU from the peak_bw_probe multi-tier sweep (chip_profile::detect_bw_tiers); ~84% of the 384-bit GDDR6@20Gbps theoretical peak (~960 GB/s), consistent with the ~86% achieved fraction seen on the other measured archs in this campaign. cache_bw_gbps=1778.8 / effective_cache_mib=16.0: RDNA3's 96MB Infinity Cache (profiler.rs::arch_spec infinity_cache_mb=96.0 for this family) shows a real cache tier — the cache-resident row's peak BW (1778.8 GB/s) clears the DRAM plateau (809.0 GB/s) by >2x, so detect_bw_tiers reports it as genuine (passes the 'cache peak must exceed DRAM plateau' guard added 2026-07-02). effective_cache_mib=16.0 is the largest swept buffer size that stayed cache-resident before the curve dropped to the DRAM plateau — an empirical observation from this probe's swept sample points, not a claim that the die's full 96MB Infinity Cache tops out at 16 MiB.
